items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Because she was a little girl that was in the show at the Cotton Club.

ctx.x: Yeah, she copied as much as she could. Because she was a little girl that was in the show at the Cotton Club. She copied as good as she could from Ethel Waters. And remember, she was a songstress with Noble Sissle's band. And bands had made more singers than anybody you could know.
